sources.name: City of Longmont: City Council calendar
sources.notes: Found and read once on 4 October 2026. The City's calendar is The Events Calendar on WordPress. Its robots.txt disallows /wp-json/, so the REST API is not read; the iCal exports under /events/ are allowed, but each stops at 30 items, which on the all-events export is two to four days, nearly all library drop-ins. So the City's calendar is proposed as one feed per department category, each reaching further. This one is the City Council category: 18 items to 29 December on 4 October (council meetings, pre-sessions, study sessions, Coffee with Council, Council at the farmers market, a fire station open house). The City marks a called-off meeting by prefixing "Canceled:" to the title rather than with STATUS:CANCELLED, so ingest will stage those as new items; three in December were marked so. America/Denver times.

sources.name: Boulder County
sources.notes: Found and read once on 4 October 2026; the same feed Niwot's and Lyons' registries confirm with their own location filter. County-wide, 30 upcoming items; the ones naming Longmont are mostly County open space and the Agricultural Heritage Center with Longmont addresses outside the city limits (Pella Crossing, Rabbit Mountain, 8348 Ute Hwy), which the guide's parks and outdoors scope takes in. Fairgrounds events also carry Longmont and are proposed separately below; ingest merges an item two feeds share.

sources.name: Downtown Longmont (Longmont Downtown Development Authority)
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: Craft CMS. The calendar page reads as plain HTML (Downtown and Creative District events, many at businesses: Kuper Wine Bar, The Blackbird House), with pages for the annuals (Day of the Dead, Costume Crawl, Wine Walk, summer concerts, holidays). robots.txt disallows /_feeds/, where a feed would live, so none is proposed. Read by hand.

sources.name: Longmont Area Chamber of Commerce
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: GrowthZone. Two calendars, the chamber's own (my.longmontchamber.org/calendar: networking, ribbon cuttings) and a community calendar; neither offers a calendar feed, only a .ics per event, and the WordPress RSS at longmontchamber.org/feed/ is news posts. The community calendar carries events outside Longmont (the first one opened was a gala in Loveland), so each item needs its location checked. Read by hand.

sources.name: Longmont Public Library (City of Longmont calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read once on 4 October 2026. The library is a City department and its programmes are on the City's calendar (see longmontcolorado-gov for why it is split by category). 30 items reached 12 October: storytimes, Stay & Play, writers' and teen groups, workshops, most at 355 Emery St. The guide's event standard leaves out most daily regulars; excludeTitles is the editor's to set.

sources.name: Longmont Parks and Natural Resources
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: the source for park, greenway and open-space listings (the directory of parks and trails, the greenways and trails page, the trail status map). Its category on the City calendar had no events, so there is no feed to read; parks events come through longmontcolorado-gov-recreation.

sources.name: Longmont Recreation Services (City of Longmont calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read once on 4 October 2026. The City's community events are filed under Recreation Services: 22 items to 12 December on 4 October, among them the Floating Pumpkin Patch, the Day of the Dead Family Celebration, the Halloween Costume Parade, the Turkey Trot, the Ice Pavilion opening and the Longmont Lights Holiday Parade, plus Callahan House events (its own category duplicates this one and is not proposed separately). Weekly items (Itty Bitty City Preschool Playtime, Free Saturday Fitness) are in it too.

sources.name: Boulder County Fairgrounds
sources.notes: Found and read once on 4 October 2026: the County's fairgrounds category, 9595 Nelson Road, Longmont. 30 items to 13 November, among them the Longmont Farmers Market every Saturday at 8 am in the North Parking Lot (the market's own site, bcfm.org, sits behind a bot challenge), the Pumpkin Pie Days and Mollie McGee's markets, the Longmont Quilt Guild show and Feria del Tamal. Horse shows and club gymkhanas are in it too and are the editor's to exclude. The Boulder County Fair in August is here.

sources.name: Dickens Opera House
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: robots.txt allows us, but the site answers automated requests with 403, so nothing could be read. Downtown's main music room; check its calendar in a browser.

sources.name: Longmont Museum (City of Longmont calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read once on 4 October 2026. The museum, 400 Quail Rd., is a City department; its Stewart Auditorium programme (Friday afternoon concerts, films co-presented with the Sundance Film Festival, talks) and its classes are on the City's calendar. 30 items reached 22 October, including the Grand Reopening Celebration on 17 October. Like the council calendar it marks changes in the title ("Postponed: ..."). Daily Discovery Days sessions are regulars.

sources.name: Longmont Symphony Orchestra
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: Squarespace, and the season page reads as plain HTML (the 60th season: 17 October, 14 November, the Nutcracker 5 and 6 December, 12 December, then 2027). Squarespace's robots.txt disallows ?format=, so its iCal export is not read. Concerts are at Vance Brand Civic Auditorium on the Skyline High campus, which has no site of its own.

sources.name: Firehouse Art Center
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: SiteGround's bot challenge (sgcaptcha) answers every automated request, so nothing could be read. Check in a browser.

sources.name: Longmont Theatre Company
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: a script-only page (a React app with an empty body) that renders only in a browser. No feed.

sources.name: Longmont Leader
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: local news, robots.txt allows us. Useful for what is coming and what has closed; a listing still rests on the organizer's or business's own page.

sources.name: Longmont Times-Call
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai, which this repo treats as an opt-out, so nothing was read and nothing should be. A person can read it.

sources.name: Boulder County Farmers Markets
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: SiteGround's bot challenge answers every automated request. The Longmont market's dates are on the County's fairgrounds feed (bouldercounty-gov-fairgrounds); check the market's own page in a browser for anything else.

sources.name: St. Vrain Historical Society
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: the home page read once, then robots.txt answered with a "temporarily unavailable" error page, which under the robots standard means stay out, so its events pages were not read. Try again before relying on it.

sources.name: Visit Longmont
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: the visitor bureau's Simpleview calendar, an aggregator of other organizers' events, so never the source of an item: anything seen here is confirmed on the organizer's own page. Its RSS (/event/rss/) carries 30 items each stamped with the day it was read rather than the event's date, so it is not proposed as a feed.
